summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwindcss-effect-lab@1.6.7
details: Package tailwindcss-effect-lab@1.6.7 was examined and no code paths matching supply-chain attack patterns were identified. There is no evidence of install-time or import-time outbound network activity, no reads of installer credential stores (~/.npmrc, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh), no environment-variable scraping, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, no hardcoded attacker-controlled endpoints, no shipped third-party credentials, and no lifecycle scripts performing privileged or destructive actions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
